Lina: Quick heads-up — Legal asked for a 2-year retention window for auth logs for a compliance audit next quarter. Our SIEM export currently keeps 90d raw. Need a short plan: export TTLs, JIT KMS unwrapping, and RBAC controls.

Ajay: Are they asking for raw PII everywhere? pushing for scrubbed/tokenized exports where possible. 2y raw will be pricey and complicates KMS rotations.

Tom: Also callout: replay + archive restores can spike SIEM ingest. If we keep 2y accessible for replays we could hit cloud SIEM quotas and blow our ingest SLOs. Need throttles and scheduled replays.

Lina: My current proposal: keep 90d raw in hot SIEM, archive 2y encrypted in a separate archival bucket encrypted with a dedicated CMK (archival-kms). Access via timeboxed JIT leases: ticket -> security review -> ephemeral unwrap token (TTL=4h). Full audit trail for every unwrap. Scrubbed views for day-to-day analysts.

Ajay: Sounds reasonable. Questions: who issues the lease? security ops UI or ticket-based? We need a clear RBAC change: analysts get scrubbed views, only 'archive_unwrapper' role (security leads + legal liaisons) can request unwraps. Also require 2FA + approval step.

security-bot: New request created: REQ-4821 — "Archive lease workflow design" assigned to Ajay. Please update the ticket with the proposed schema. (automated)

Tom: SRE notes: for large replays we should gate with siem.ingest.throttle and require off-peak windows. Suggested defaults: 1000 events/s per tenant for replay jobs, and staged manifest exports for >10M events. Also tag archive jobs with cost-center metadata.

Lina: Proposed lease flow (draft):

1) Legal opens ticket: /request-archive <tenant> <start> <end> <justification>
2) Security ops review (1 business day SLA)
3) If approved, mint ephemeral KMS unwrap token tied to CMK 'archival-kms' with TTL=4h; stream unwrapped data to secure archival-bucket with download ACLs limited to lease principals
4) All unwrap/download events emit detailed audit events to audit-log-bucket and create an immutable evidence record
5) Token auto-revoked at TTL expiry; any replays > threshold require staged exports and SRE coordination

CLI example:
```
/request-archive --tenant=acme --start=2023-01-01 --end=2023-06-01 --justification="legal hold"
```

Ajay: I'll draft the RBAC change: roles 'archive_unwrapper' + 'read_scrubbed_logs', include approval flow and require MFA & ticket link in the grant. Will put up PR + RFC.

oncall-sre: Also add these operational safeguards:
- If export size > 10M events, require manifest/batch export (no single streaming job)
- Presigned URLs for downloads with short TTLs instead of long-lived credentials
- Backpressure hooks in SIEM connector (HTTP 429 -> retry with exponential backoff)

Lina: Action items:
- Ajay: draft RBAC PR & ticket template (due 2025-01-15)
- Tom: add ingest throttle + replay gating to runbook and test plan (due 2025-01-10)
- Lina: update compliance response doc and KMS key policy for 'archival-kms' (due 2025-01-12)
- security-bot: schedule follow-ups and reminders for REQ-4821

Please ack.

Ajay: ack :+1:

Tom: ack :thumbsup:
